HIEROPHANT2-ENDURE.title: Endure
HIEROPHANT2-ENDURE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
At the end of the turn, return {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard[/gold] pile to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Retain[/gold] it.

HIEROPHANT2-FELLOWSHIP.description: At the start of the next X{IfUpgraded:show:+1|} turns, you and the enemy gain {BlockAmount:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

HIEROPHANT2-HOLY_VESTMENTS.description:

HIEROPHANT2-LAY_ON_HANDS.description:

[gold]Gilded[/gold].

(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}

HIEROPHANT2-MERCENARIES.description:

(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}

(Draws {CardsToDraw:diff()} {CardsToDraw:plural:card|cards})}
[gold]Hoard[/gold] {Hoard:diff()}.

[gold]Gilded[/gold].
